(1) the linguistic expression of physicians in the form of acoustic and lexical features is linked to their diagnostic correctness and (2) this link can be modeled and predicted computationally with high accuracy (F1 = 0.82).

(1) the acoustic and lexical features that we extracted are predictive of diagnostic correctness; (2) the lexical features that we used were more predictive than the acoustic ones; and (3) the lexical features were more predictive than those from the acoustic domain.

(1) there is a link between linguistic expression in physicians' narratives and diagnostic correctness; (2) the linguistic features that capture this link are related to uncertainty in physicians' narratives; and (3) the link can be modeled and predicted computationally with a reasonable accuracy.
